Subject: Birchley Logistics - Questions for Quote

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the Birchley Logistics submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

Before I can finalize a quote, I have a few questions:

- Can you provide details on the security and fire protection systems at each of the three locations?
- What are the building construction types and occupancy details for each site?
- Are there any high-hazard operations or storage (e.g., flammables, hazardous materials)?
- What are the current deductibles and any coverage enhancements they're looking for?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive quote for the December 4, 2026 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
